reden: Stopping at turn 7 of 10. All four pillars have as much support as the sources allow. Intervention: Archmage admits off-register authorization in ARC-106 (dag 8), which matches the unnamed 'hogerhand' approval in ENG-105 (dag 9). The second pols was activated at dag 10 02:40 per ENG-011 and ENG-106. Mechanism: no source isolates a causal link; ARC-109 and ARC-116 are admitted inference, and the Historian, Guardian Keeper and Beast Master confirm no shutdown, backup or coverage-gap rule beyond HIS-110. Timeline: the Archmage's per-date readings give dag 7 baseline, dag 14 dips and dag 21 recovery; the four-day rhythm runs from dag 10 to dag 42 (BEA and ORA), with the Oracle predicting dag 46 at about 04:15-04:45. Contradictions are resolved: HIS-036 and HIS-053 are logged before they happen and remain unexplained in the archive; the Engineer withdrew the hacker claim (ENG-110); the Oracle withdrew the ORA-121 prediction. Remaining gaps are source-absent (no numeric shield values, no dag 14 hour, no independent confirmation of the dag 24 5% step-up, no shutdown prerequisite), so further turns would only re-ask for logs that members have confirmed do not exist.
